Package com.bilt.pos.session.settlement

Class SettlementResult

java.lang.Object
com.bilt.pos.session.settlement.SettlementResult
public final class SettlementResult extends Object
Final outcome of a successful settlement orchestration.

The loyalty award is best-effort (the terminal stores-and-forwards when the loyalty host is down): a failed award does not fail the checkout but is reported in getWarnings().
